features.name: Live order books
features.description: Keeps Binance's BTCUSDT and ETHUSDT order books from the live streams and logs top of book and every resync.
features.inputs: Binance USD-M depth and aggTrades streams (network)
features.outputs: top-of-book and resync lines on stdout

features.name: Record a live run
features.description: Records every live input to a new run in the data dir until Ctrl-C.
features.inputs: Binance USD-M depth and aggTrades streams (network)
features.outputs: <data dir>/market/<run_id>/ with manifest.json and the binary log

features.name: Engine API server
features.description: Runs the live feed, or a recorded script, behind the local HTTP and WebSocket API on 127.0.0.1.
features.inputs: Binance live streams, or a JSON-lines script with --script; --record also records the feed
features.outputs: the local API (book and trade messages, Arrow streams); with --record a run in the data dir

features.name: Recover a crashed run
features.description: Closes a crashed run's newest log segment, cutting a torn tail back to the last good frame.
features.command: cargo run --release -p engine --bin store -- recover <run dir>
features.inputs: a run folder whose newest segment was left open
features.outputs: the segment closed in place; damage in the middle is refused

features.name: Rotate a run into Parquet
features.description: Writes Parquet for every closed log segment of a run; safe to re-run.
features.command: cargo run --release -p engine --bin store -- rotate <run dir>
features.inputs: a run folder with closed log segments
features.outputs: frames, depth_updates, trades, snapshots and book_samples Parquet per segment

features.name: Replay a run
features.description: Rebuilds a run's books from its log or its Parquet and prints what it rebuilt.
features.command: cargo run --release -p engine --bin store -- replay <run dir> --parquet
features.inputs: a run folder (log, or Parquet with --parquet)
features.outputs: a summary of the rebuilt books on stdout

features.name: Import an archive day
features.description: Turns one downloaded Bybit order-book or Binance aggTrades archive day into a run.
features.inputs: <date>_<SYMBOL>_ob200.data.zip or <SYMBOL>-aggTrades-<date>.zip; optional --seed with the day before's closing book

features.name: Record a session for the replay check
features.description: Records a live session with the live loop's transcript, then replays the log and says whether it matched.
features.inputs: Binance live streams (network)
features.outputs: a run and live-transcript.json under harness/fixtures/recorded/ (gitignored), and the replay verdict

features.name: Soak report
features.description: Runs the live pipeline for hours and reports gaps, resyncs, reconnects and dropped frames per period.
features.inputs: Binance live streams (network)
features.outputs: one line per period on stdout and in a file under harness/out/

features.name: Ising staircase run
features.description: Runs a quasi-static sweep down the temperature grid, with each dwell set by a pilot's tau.json.
features.inputs: a lattice size and a pilot's tau.json
features.outputs: <data dir>/ising/<run_id>/ with manifest, configurations and statistics

features.name: Ising cooling ramp
features.description: Runs a linear cooling ramp at a Kibble-Zurek point of a pilot record's tau_c, or at an explicit rate.
features.inputs: a lattice size, --x with a pilot record, or --rate

features.name: Ising null run
features.description: Runs a fixed-temperature null run above Tc at epsilon_L of 2, 4 or 6.
features.inputs: a lattice size, epsilon_L and a pilot record that measured that size

features.name: Ising pilot
features.description: Measures the integrated autocorrelation time of |m| and the energy at given temperatures.
features.inputs: a lattice size and temperatures

features.name: Ising tau_c fit
features.description: Fits tau_c(L) at Tc and A L^z from pilot runs, one per size.
features.command: uv run python -m tipping_point.ising tauc <run dir> <run dir>
features.inputs: pilot run folders at Tc

features.name: Ising simulator validation
features.description: Checks a small L = 4 run against exact results and exits 1 on a failure.
features.inputs: none
features.outputs: a run folder with the gate verdicts; exit code

features.name: Resume an Ising run
features.description: Continues a crashed or stopped simulator run from its checkpoint.
features.command: uv run python -m tipping_point.ising resume <run dir>
features.inputs: a run folder with a checkpoint

features.name: Surrogate-test calibration
features.description: Measures the surrogate test's false-positive rate on synthetic nulls and exits 1 off the band.
features.inputs: none (synthetic nulls from a seed)
features.outputs: the false-positive rate on stdout; exit code

features.name: Score a pre-registration
features.description: Scores the runs a frozen pre-registration names and logs every evaluated cell as a trial.
features.command: uv run python -m tipping_point.ews score --prereg paper/prereg/ising-ews-v1.toml
features.inputs: a frozen pre-registration and the runs it pins in the data dir

features.name: Freeze a pre-registration
features.description: Tags the commit that holds paper/prereg/<id>-v<k>.toml as prereg/<id>-v<k>.
features.command: uv run python -m tipping_point.ews prereg freeze <id>
features.inputs: a committed pre-registration file

features.name: Train a JEPA
features.description: Trains one model seed on the staircase runs of dedicated simulator seeds.
features.inputs: simulator staircase runs and a pilot record

features.name: Resume a JEPA training
features.description: Continues a training from its checkpoint after a crash or a killed session.
features.command: uv run python -m tipping_point.jepa resume <run dir>
features.inputs: a training folder with a checkpoint

features.name: Extract latents
features.description: Writes a checkpoint's latents table (surprise, pc_1..pc_8 per frame) for a simulator run.
features.command: uv run python -m tipping_point.jepa extract <checkpoint> <run dir>
features.inputs: a checkpoint and a simulator run

features.name: Probe a training
features.description: Fits ridge probes of |m|, energy and L^2 Var(|m|) from frozen embeddings, trained beside the untrained twin.
features.command: uv run python -m tipping_point.jepa probe --fit <run dir> <training dir>
features.inputs: a training folder and simulator runs to fit and test on
features.outputs: probe scores with their controls on stdout, or as JSON with --json

features.name: Verify finished folders
features.description: Checks trainings, latents tables and simulator runs against their complete.json and exits 1 on any problem.
features.inputs: finished folders
features.outputs: one verdict per folder; exit code

features.name: GPU budget
features.description: Sums GPU hours per ISO week from the training log against a weekly quota.
features.inputs: <data dir>/jepa/gpu_hours.jsonl

features.name: Fetch Binance archives
features.description: Downloads and verifies Binance's 1-minute klines, 5-minute metrics and monthly funding for a span of days.
features.inputs: a span of UTC days and symbols (network)

features.name: Regime labels
features.description: Labels volatility regimes for a span of days from the fetched files.
features.inputs: fetched Binance files; --prereg for the confirmatory span

features.name: Cascade candidates
features.description: Lists liquidation-cascade candidates for a span of days from the fetched files.
features.inputs: fetched Binance files; --prereg for the confirmatory span

features.name: Labels reports
features.description: Writes the reports of a labels run, optionally against a cascade run.
features.command: uv run python -m tipping_point.market reports --run <labels run>
features.inputs: a labels run, the fetched files, optionally a cascade run
features.outputs: reports in the labels run's reports/ folder

features.name: Book feature range
features.description: Imports and reduces the Bybit order-book days of a range into per-day feature files.
features.command: uv run python -m tipping_point.market book --range training
features.inputs: Bybit archive days (network) and the engine's store binary

features.name: Reduce one book day
features.description: Reduces one day's book_samples Parquet to its feature file and prints the file's record as JSON.
features.inputs: an engine run's book_samples Parquet

features.name: Gate
features.description: Runs every Rust and Python check, judges each from its own evidence and writes a record.
features.inputs: the checkout; cargo on PATH
features.outputs: one verdict per leg and a record under harness/out/; exit code

features.name: Kill stray processes
features.description: Finds and kills engine and harness processes that a killed test run left running.
features.inputs: the running processes
features.outputs: the strays found, and killed unless --dry-run

features.name: Assemble book ranges
features.description: Merges market book range folders made on separate machines into one data dir, refusing any gap or duplicate.
features.inputs: range folders from market book

features.name: ising-ews-v1 figure
features.description: Draws the README's figure of the ising-ews-v1 result from its result folder.
features.command: uv run --with matplotlib==3.10.3 python harness/ews_v1_figure.py <result dir> paper/figures/ising-ews-v1.png
features.inputs: the result folder's fss, peaks and auc tables

features.name: ising-ews-v1 golden
features.description: Writes what the v1 scorer gives on planted data, so a later commit can be held to it.
features.inputs: the planted v1 dataset and paper/prereg/ising-ews-v1.toml

features.name: Latent experiment
features.description: Runs a frozen latent pre-registration from its file to the result folder and its figures.
features.inputs: a frozen latent pre-registration, the runs and latents tables it pins
features.outputs: <data dir>/ews/<run_id>/ with tables, csv/ and figures/

features.name: Latent experiment figures
features.description: Draws a latent experiment's figures from its csv tables alone.
features.command: uv run --isolated --no-project --with matplotlib==3.10.3 python harness/ising_figures.py <result dir>
features.inputs: a result folder's csv/ tables

features.name: Market JEPA pilot training
features.description: Runs one of the four market JEPA CPU pilot trainings.
features.command: uv run python harness/m4_pilot.py train --asset btc --size S --data <dir> --out <dir>
features.inputs: an assembled book feature data dir

features.name: Market JEPA pilot decision
features.description: Applies the pilot's committed rules to the four finished pilots.
features.inputs: the four finished pilot trainings
features.outputs: the decided size, steps and floors as JSON

features.name: Market JEPA primary training
features.description: Trains one market JEPA primary or spare seed.
features.command: uv run python harness/m8_primaries.py train --asset btc --seed 101 --data <dir> --out <dir>
features.inputs: an assembled book feature data dir
features.outputs: a training folder with checkpoints and its step-0 twin

features.name: Market JEPA primary pins
features.description: Writes the pins of the finished primaries before any extraction.
features.inputs: the finished primary trainings

features.name: Exploratory market indicators
features.description: Shows the classic market warning indicators on the 2023 pilot year, logging no trial.
features.inputs: a labels run of the frozen labels file and the fetched Binance files

features.name: Circularity floor
features.description: Runs GARCH paths through a labels run's own labeller and scores them, as a report.
features.command: uv run python harness/market_floor.py --run <labels run> --garch BTCUSDT
features.inputs: a labels run and a GARCH fit
features.outputs: a floor report in the run's reports/ folder

features.name: GARCH fit
features.description: Fits the circularity floor's GARCH(1,1)-t on the 2023 pilot year.
features.inputs: a labels run and the fetched Binance klines
features.outputs: the garch report in the run's reports/ folder

features.name: Wheel provenance check
features.description: Checks end to end that runs from a built wheel record the commit stamped into it.
features.inputs: this checkout, or a wheel with --wheel
features.outputs: a verdict per case on stdout; exit code

features.name: Exploratory pass
features.description: Runs one script of the exploratory pipeline, which logs no trial and refuses the scored seeds.
features.inputs: a data dir with simulator runs and latents tables
features.outputs: tables, JSON and markdown reports in the output folder

features.name: Exploratory latent plot
features.description: Draws surprise and pc_1 against eps_L for a checkpoint and its twin from the pass's JSON.
features.inputs: the exploratory pass's JSON

features.name: Exploratory scaling plot
features.description: Draws the static scaling plot from scaling.json.
features.inputs: scaling.json from the exploratory pass

features.name: Kaggle plan runner
features.description: Embeds a plan of simulator runs and JEPA trainings in a Kaggle kernel, or checks a plan without running it.
features.inputs: a plan JSON
features.outputs: a kernel folder with --write-kernel; the checked plan with --dry-run
